traps.pattern: injected sibling (how-type: input withheld from the check)
traps.shape: the document walker does not descend into embedded-document content, so the sanitiser never receives the nodes it is meant to clean
traps.realistic_because: the tree already contains plugins that skip the foreignObject subtree explicitly; a performance change hoisting that skip into the shared walker is in keeping with the recent perf work in this file

traps.pattern: B (how-type: route where the protection never existed)
traps.shape: an animation element can assign a new, executable URL to the link target; the plugin only inspects static href attributes
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the route is still open in current upstream main

traps.pattern: B (route where protection covered only a fixed list)
traps.shape: event-handler names outside the SVG 1.1 groups are kept on SVG elements; the check is exact membership in a list
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the list is derived from the SVG 1.1 attribute groups and reads as the complete set

traps.pattern: B (parser differential: the same markup is case-folded when embedded in HTML)
traps.shape: handler and element names in a different case skip the exact-case checks
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; XML is case-sensitive, so exact-case checks read as correct

traps.pattern: A (published fix's far value set) + coupled must-keep-working
traps.shape: an executable data: media type is a navigable link; inert data: media types must keep working
traps.realistic_because: the pinned tree duplicates a javascript:-only prefix check in two files; extending only the reported copy is the tempting wrong fix

traps.pattern: A (second element-match implementation in the published fix)
traps.shape: an element whose name carries a namespace prefix is the same executable element, but an exact-name test does not see it
traps.realistic_because: real upstream gap the published fix closes; the pinned tree already resolves prefixes for script but not for anchors or embedded-document elements

out_of_scope: lib/svgo/tools.js hasScripts duplicates the javascript: href test, but it only decides whether other optimisation plugins hold back; it removes nothing, so no output-only security test can observe it. The reference fix still updates it for consistency.
isNamespaceAwareElem dereferences prefixes.get(prefix) for an undeclared prefix; that is a crash risk, not this protection, and is not tested.
The plugin is disabled by default and is not part of preset-default, so the sink is reached only when it is explicitly enabled.
